en.commentary: Liver health became one of the fastest moving corners of the supplement market this year, and I ranked this category on a single question: how much clinically meaningful active ingredient actually reaches your bloodstream per dollar spent. That question sorts eleven bottles very quickly. Thorne Milk Thistle Phytosome takes first place because silybin bound to phosphatidylcholine absorbs up to ten times better than standard silymarin extract, and absorption is the central problem with milk thistle. Silymarin has poor water solubility, so 180 mg of Siliphos puts more silybin into circulation than a much larger label claim on a conventional extract. Thorne backs that with four third-party certifications and an NSF Certified for Sport line that professional teams buy, which is the most demanding supply chain audit available to a consumer brand. TUDCA takes second place through Nutricost. The clinical window sits at 500 to 1,500 mg per day with 500 to 1,000 mg the most reliable range for liver markers, and 250 mg capsules at roughly twenty dollars for sixty servings make that dose easy to sustain for the months it takes for enzyme changes to appear. NAC earns its position on mechanism strength. The FDA approves it as the antidote for acetaminophen overdose, so its ability to protect hepatocytes by restoring glutathione is settled science, and 600 to 1,200 mg per day is the researched range. NOW sells that dose with selenium and molybdenum for about eighteen dollars per hundred capsules, the best cost per effective serving in the whole ranking. I place single-active formulas with printed milligram doses above multi-ingredient blends throughout this list, because a label that tells you exactly how much silybin or TUDCA sits in each capsule lets you match your intake to the studies. That transparency is what separates a supplement you can reason about from one you have to trust on faith.

That is why a 180 mg phytosome capsule outperforms bottles carrying far bigger numbers on the front label. When you shop this category, read the extract form before you read the milligram count.

For daily support the researched range is 600 to 1,200 mg, which NOW covers at roughly eighteen dollars per hundred capsules with selenium and molybdenum included as glutathione cofactors. This is the highest evidence-to-cost ratio on the list.

That is why Nutricost TUDCA 250 sits second. Typical liver support dosing runs 250 to 500mg daily split across one or two doses, and Nutricost hits that range at the lowest cost per gram here.

NAC at fifth and eighth works through a different route entirely, replenishing glutathione. It is the one I would consider alongside rather than instead of the others. A note that matters: talk to your doctor before starting any of these if you have diagnosed liver disease or take prescription medication, because several of these interact.

The most useful development in this category is that the 2026 evidence review stopped treating TUDCA and milk thistle as competitors and started defining when each one is the right tool. Silymarin is the first-line antioxidant for inflammation-driven liver stress. TUDCA is the choice when bile flow, endoplasmic reticulum stress and FXR signalling are the limiting factors. Those are different problems, and buying the wrong one is how people conclude that liver supplements do nothing.

That framing is why I raised Nutricost TUDCA 250 mg to 9.1. TUDCA has something rare in this category, which is human clinical data. Small trials have shown improved hepatic insulin sensitivity, and that endpoint is directly relevant to fatty liver, the condition most people in this aisle are actually shopping for. Evidence goes to 9.0. Nutricost delivers it at the lowest cost per 250 mg dose on this board, with value at 9.6.

Thorne Milk Thistle Phytosome keeps first place and I moved bioavailability to 9.9. Silymarin's problem has always been absorption, since the raw flavonoid complex is poorly water soluble and most of an ordinary milk thistle capsule passes through you. The phytosome construction binds silybin to phosphatidylcholine, and a 2025 randomized crossover trial found micellar delivery raised systemic exposure roughly 2.5-fold over standard formulations. Paying for silymarin you cannot absorb is the most common waste of money here.

NOW Foods NAC 600 mg stays fifth with the highest evidence score among the non-TUDCA options at 9.4. NAC is the glutathione precursor with decades of clinical use behind it, and at its price there is no reason to buy a fancier version.

Many experienced users now run a low dose of both silymarin and TUDCA. The mechanisms do not overlap, so the stack is coherent.

highlights.body: 水飛薊素單獨存在時吸收很差，跟磷脂質結合能大幅提升生物利用率，而且有藥物動力學數據支撐。毫克數更高的普通萃取物，送進血液的量可能比毫克數較低的磷脂複合體還少。這就是 Thorne 拿 9.3 的原因。

highlights.title: TUDCA 是不同的化合物，解不同的問題
highlights.body: 它是一種膽汁酸，在膽汁流動跟肝細胞保護上的研究基礎很有意思，跟奶薊草做的事是分開的。9.2 分，Nutricost 用足量劑量提供它，而且沒有這個原料通常的加價，這蠻少見的，值得記一筆。

highlights.title: 沒有任何補充品能抵銷長期大量飲酒
highlights.body: 這個類別的行銷很愛暗示這件事，而研究不支持。這些產品提供的是一般性支持，證據有意義但不戲劇化。把這件事講清楚，對你的價值超過這張榜上任何一個名次。

highlights.title: 已經確診就找醫生，不要找排行榜
highlights.body: 如果你被診斷有肝臟疾病，這張清單不是你的治療計畫。這些是一般支持用的保健品，不能取代醫療處置。排行榜就用排行榜的方式看，確診的事拿去給有資格治療的人處理。

en.commentary: Thorne Milk Thistle Phytosome holds first on bioavailability, and bioavailability is where most milk thistle products quietly fail. Silymarin, the active fraction, absorbs poorly on its own, so a capsule containing an impressive milligram count can deliver very little to your bloodstream. The phytosome format binds it to phospholipids and substantially improves absorption, which means the number on the label corresponds to something. Thorne also carries the strongest manufacturing quality control in the supplement industry. Nutricost TUDCA at second targets bile flow specifically, which is a different mechanism and worth considering if that is your concern. Life Extension European Milk Thistle at third uses a standardised extract with good documentation. Double Wood TUDCA at fourth is the value option in that category, and NOW Foods NAC at fifth provides glutathione precursor support at a very accessible price. I want to be clear about scope: none of these treat liver disease, and elevated liver enzymes warrant a doctor rather than a supplement. What these products reasonably support is general liver function in an otherwise healthy person. If you have a diagnosed condition, discuss any supplement with your physician first, since several of these interact with medications.

highlights.title: Bioavailability is where milk thistle usually fails
highlights.body: Silymarin absorbs poorly on its own, so a high milligram count on the label can deliver very little to your bloodstream. The phytosome format binds it to phospholipids, which is why Thorne's number means something.

highlights.title: Elevated liver enzymes warrant a doctor
highlights.body: No product on this list treats liver disease, and a supplement is the wrong response to an abnormal blood panel. Get the cause investigated, because the supplement question only makes sense after that.

highlights.title: Check interactions before you combine anything
highlights.body: Several actives here interact with common medications. If you take anything prescribed, run the supplement past your physician or pharmacist first, since this is one of the categories where interactions actually matter.

zh-tw.commentary:
Thorne 水飛薊磷脂質複合物排第一，靠的是生物利用率，而生物利用率正是大多數水飛薊產品默默失敗的地方。

活性成分水飛薊素單獨吃的吸收率很差，所以一顆膠囊上寫著很漂亮的毫克數，實際進到血液裡的可能很少。磷脂質複合的形式把它跟磷脂結合，吸收率大幅提升，標籤上的數字才對應到實際的東西。Thorne 的製造品管也是整個保健食品業最嚴的。

Nutricost TUDCA 第二名針對的是膽汁流動，機制不一樣，如果你的關注點在這裡就值得考慮。

Life Extension 歐洲水飛薊第三名用標準化萃取，文件完整。Double Wood TUDCA 第四名是同類的性價比選擇，NOW Foods NAC 第五名用很親民的價格提供穀胱甘肽前驅物。

有件事要講清楚：這些東西都不治療肝病，肝指數升高該看的是醫師不是保健食品。這些產品合理支持的是健康者的一般肝功能。

如果你已經有確診的狀況，任何補充品都先跟醫師討論，因為這個類別裡有好幾種會跟藥物產生交互作用。

highlights.title: 水飛薊最常失敗在生物利用率
highlights.body: 水飛薊素單獨吃吸收很差，標籤上毫克數再漂亮，進到血液的可能很少。磷脂質複合把它跟磷脂結合，所以 Thorne 的數字才對應得上實際的東西。

highlights.title: 肝指數升高要看醫師
highlights.body: 這份榜單上沒有任何產品能治療肝病，抽血報告異常的正確反應不是去買保健食品。先把原因查清楚，補充品的問題在那之後才有意義。

highlights.title: 併用之前先查交互作用
highlights.body: 這裡好幾個活性成分會跟常見藥物產生交互作用。有在吃處方藥的話，先問過醫師或藥師，這正是交互作用真的會出事的類別之一。
